book.name: METIU
book.title: Yeisu Wasane Dodohobine Metiu wana Luluweli

content: Greip hana Baguye hana Tokaiwo hana Gohalibe
Helak wana bagalogugui sohode ti ya. Tolomo hotiya henenai suwok i setagi i pataemid bobode topadine ge si la si kaiwo he wana greip hana baguye.
I liwo heidiye i nga, “Yan ya bwele a pamaisemiu silba pele-tiya sohode yan hotiya maisane.” Sidiye si nga, “I dohob,” habeto i patileid si la si kaiwo he wana greip hana baguye.
He naen oklok i setagi hedi, i paidiid bobode topadine si midimidi he bagamaket, si mimibwage ege.
Bwen i liwo heidiye i nga, “Humiu hedi, gen hu la hu kaiwo he lo greip hana baguye, iloke a giyau vetahe maisamiu, taine bwele a deginawi pangak heimiu.”
Bwen si lok. Parae luwane ge he tri oklok i setagi ge i ginawi sohode hedi.
Hawesine ege paib oklok bwen i setagi hedi ge i paidiid bobode topadine si midimidi. Bwen i tayakid i nga, “Sahe kaiwane hu midimidi he ya, yan bwabwaligane hu mimibwage ege?”
Si golase halingane si nga, “Kaiwane taine tolomo hotiya i deyomoyai kaiwo kaiwane.” Bwen i liwo heidiye, “Humiu hedi, gen hu la hu kaiwo he lo greip hana baguye.”

Hobak i kokoyavi suwok, baguye tonuwage i liwo tokaiwo hedi tomatahasik heine i nga, “U gonid tokaiwo ge maisadiye u giyau, u telipune hebwaden a bigi dumuyaiid heidiye ge u pwamwao henebwaden ga a bigi deiyanid heidiye.”
Hebwaden si kaiwo telipune paib oklok kokoyavi si luwom ge si howo maisadiye hana kaikai sohode yan bwabwaligane maisane, si lotomase silba pele-tiya ngangane.
Iyete sauge hebwaden i bigi deiyanid si luwom, si nuwotu tage bwele maisadiye si eho pakai, age sidiye hedi, bwabwaligadiye si ho silba pele-tiya ngangane.
Saugeine maisadiye si howo, bwen si telipune si lobaeyan baguye tonuwagane,
si nga, “Bobode hebwaden u bigiid dumuyai ya, si kaiwo patanmwalao, age hamai he parae rarareine ha logaisi he yan bwabwaligane, bwen u pamaiseyai sohode hedi sidiye.”
I golase halingadiye ge i liwo bwaidiye hotiya heine i nga, “Heliya, taine a deginawi pangak heim. Wente u taeman yan bwabwaligane u kaiwo maisam silba pele-tiya, age?
Maisam u howo ge u yogo. Nuwau tolomo gane a howo muyai maisane a giyau heine sohode hedi a giyau heim.
Age tage tan bosowaiu totou lo mwani a dehowo ge a deginawi sohode sahe a nuwotuyan, ine? Nau a muloluyanid bobode, mwatan ge u yamwakabu-yanau?”
Bwen Yeisu i nga, “Sohode ti yo, hebwaden sauge ya si midumuyai bwele si midei, ge hebwaden sauge ya si midei bwele si midumuyai.”
Yeisu I Lihulihu Pe-tuwonine wana Mate kaiwane
Sauge Yeisu i ela Jerusalem kaiwane, i sehapeid wana topadavae si he-yawate si he-iwo (12), iloke sidiye ege habe i lihulihu heidiye i nga,
“Hobak ta ela Jerusalem kaiwane, iloke Tolomo Natune bwele si taeman topowo lalahine ge Logugui hana topapalapu he nimadiye. Iye hana logugui bwele si ginawi gen i mate
ge si hotei hebwaden taine Judiya-yan sohode he nimadiye. Bwen sidiye si yamwa tunetune-yan, si rabrabik-an ge si tagakoros-yan. He yan ho-tuwonine habe i suwoyukim he mate.”
Jems ge Jon Tinadiye wana Hawanun
Habeto Sebedi poniyene i luwom Yeisu heine, he-bwaine he-nanatune bobode si toiwo, Jems ge Jon, ilok i lipwakoko Yeisu he matane ge i hawanun heine.

Yeisu i liwo heine i nga, “Sahe nunuwam?” Bwen vaini ya i nga, “U liwo tei heyau, sauge hebe u howo lam bagalogugui, he-nanatu si he-iwo ya si tuwodau he bagamiye hahawatauine, hotiya he lam hinone ge hotiya he lam gegebe.”
Yeisu i liwo heidiye i nga, “Taine hu delapu te sahe hu hahawanun-an. Bosowaimiu ege tilao hana kom gane habe a mun hei bwele hu mun hei?” Si golase halingane si nga, “Bam, bosowaimai ege.”

Habeto i liwo heidiye i nga, “Tolosuwok, habe hu mun he lo kom heine, age taine bosowau a deliwo sega bwele i tuwodau he lo hinone o hebe sega i tuwodau he lo gegebe. Bagamiye hebwaden yake Tamau i lovivine-yan henebwaden i haseid ege kaiwadiye.”
Sauge topadavae si he-yawate (10) si longe wase ya, bwen si hata mamaliye-yanid Jems ge Jon.

Habeto Yeisu i gon paseid topadavae si lok heine ge i nga, “Hu lapu, hebwaden taine si degoru Helak heine, wedi tologugui-yan si logugui-yanid ge wedi todedei si pagaisi wedi logugui he-bwaidiye heidiye.
Agegene humiu tab sohode ti yake. Sega hebe nuwane hidane i kai he gamwamiu, gen i tabwa lemi tokaiwo.
Ge sega hebe nuwane sohode todedei, gen i tabwa lemi hepapatile.
Sohode nau Tolomo Natune taine a deluwom tage hu kaiwo heyau, agegene a luwom gen a kaiwo heimiu, ge a taeman yawediu iloke a pamaise pahavileid bobode si hoyowate.”
Yeisu I Palale Tomatagin Si He-iwo Matadiye
Sauge Yeisu he-bwaine wana topadavae si seyok Jeriko, boda non lak si sedumuyai Yeisu he muine.
Tomatagin si he-iwo si tutuwodau he hiyede hadidine, ge sauge si longe Yeisu i sehadidiid, bwen si gon si nga, “Guyau, Deivid Tubune, u nuwalolu-yanai.”
Boda si goyamwarare-yanid ge si liwo heidiye tage si emipahab, agegene sidiye habe si gon gaigaisi si nga, “Guyau, Deivid Tubune, u nuwalolu-yanai.”
Yeisu i setalmidi, bwen i gon heidiye ge i tayak i nga, “Sahe nuwamiu a ginawi kaiwamiu?”
Si golase halingane si nga, “Guyau, nuwamai u palale matamai.”
Yeisu i hatatilao-yanid ge i pihasik matadiye, bwen he sauge yake matadiye si palale ge si sedumuyai heine.
